skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractional parts and rewrite the fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Compute simplified fractional difference
skills.definition: After fractions share a denominator, subtract numerators over that denominator and express the fractional result in lowest terms, as zero, or as an omitted zero part when appropriate.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole parts
skills.definition: Decompose mixed numbers or whole numbers into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts separately, and combine the resulting parts, including carrying a fractional part unchanged when no fractional subtraction is present.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units when the tentative fractional subtraction is negative.
